_comment: CURATED, not generated. `threat` is sent to Jev verbatim, so write it as a clause that reads well inside a question and never name the hero in it. `tags` must come from THREAT_TAGS in src/main/advise/tags.ts. Uncurated heroes degrade to popularity-only ranking and are never sent to the model (plan M3.2).

npc_dota_hero_riki.threat: permanent invisibility, silence on a smoke cloud, and attacks that hit from behind
npc_dota_hero_riki.kit: turns invisible to reposition behind a target and relies on attacking from the back, with a smoke that silences

npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.threat: permanent invisibility, tracking that reveals and slows, and burst damage from stealth
npc_dota_hero_bounty_hunter.kit: opens from invisibility with a stun and tracks one hero for team-wide gold and vision

npc_dota_hero_clinkz.threat: invisibility while moving and very high single-target attack damage
npc_dota_hero_clinkz.kit: attacks from invisibility alongside summoned archers, killing single targets quickly

npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.threat: invisibility while stationary, a stun, and burst damage that scales with the target's intelligence
npc_dota_hero_nyx_assassin.kit: waits invisible and stationary, then stuns and bursts a high-intelligence target in the back line

npc_dota_hero_lion.threat: two long single-target disables, a mana drain, and a large single-target magic burst
npc_dota_hero_lion.kit: chains two single-target disables into a large magic burst, and has to land them from range

npc_dota_hero_lina.threat: a long stun and very large single-target magic burst from range
npc_dota_hero_lina.kit: gains attack speed from casting, and lands a long stun before a very large single-target nuke

npc_dota_hero_zuus.threat: global magic damage that ignores position, and heavy area magic damage in fights
npc_dota_hero_zuus.kit: casts repeatedly through a fight for area magic damage and finishes wounded heroes globally

npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.threat: long slows, a single-target freeze, and a large channelled area ultimate
npc_dota_hero_crystal_maiden.kit: gives the team mana regeneration and channels a long area ultimate that must not be interrupted

npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.threat: a bouncing stun, area damage over time, and a channelled single-target ultimate that kills quickly
npc_dota_hero_witch_doctor.kit: channels a single-target ultimate that kills very quickly, and has to survive the channel

npc_dota_hero_bane.threat: a channelled single-target disable, a long sleep, and a single-target nightmare
npc_dota_hero_bane.kit: channels a single-target hold and needs to stay alive while keeping one hero out of the fight

npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.threat: two long single-target disables and summoned towers that push structures fast
npc_dota_hero_shadow_shaman.kit: chains two long disables and summons towers to push, and has to get into cast range safely

npc_dota_hero_enigma.threat: a channelled ultimate that holds a whole team in place, plus summoned units that farm and push
npc_dota_hero_enigma.kit: gets into position unseen and channels an ultimate that has to catch several heroes at once

npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.threat: an area time stop that freezes everyone inside it, and very high attack damage with evasion
npc_dota_hero_faceless_void.kit: drops an area time stop that must land on several heroes, then attacks freely inside it

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.threat: a long area stun that starts fights, and very high physical resilience
npc_dota_hero_tidehunter.kit: starts fights with a long area stun that has to catch the enemy grouped together

npc_dota_hero_axe.threat: a forced taunt that pulls several heroes in, and an execute that kills damaged targets outright
npc_dota_hero_axe.kit: taunts several heroes at once and has to stand among them long enough to survive it

npc_dota_hero_magnataur.threat: an area stun that drags heroes together and a large attack-damage buff for allies
npc_dota_hero_magnataur.kit: drags heroes together with an area stun and buffs allied attack damage

npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.threat: chained area stuns and burst area damage that scales with how many heroes are grouped
npc_dota_hero_earthshaker.kit: sets up with a fissure and a blind, then lands an area ultimate whose damage scales with how many heroes it catches

npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.threat: a forced one-on-one duel that cannot be escaped and grows their damage permanently
npc_dota_hero_legion_commander.kit: forces a duel that cannot be escaped and grows permanent damage from winning it

npc_dota_hero_pudge.threat: a long-range hook that drags a hero out of position, followed by a channelled hold
npc_dota_hero_pudge.kit: hooks one hero out of position from long range and holds them there

npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.threat: a global initiation that isolates one hero inside a cage
npc_dota_hero_rattletrap.kit: initiates from across the map and locks one hero in a cage away from their allies

npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.threat: silence and a blind, with a large power spike that makes night-time fights very dangerous
npc_dota_hero_night_stalker.kit: silences and blinds, and is far stronger at night when it has to start the fights

npc_dota_hero_silencer.threat: a global silence and a passive that drains intelligence permanently
npc_dota_hero_silencer.kit: silences the whole enemy team globally and steals intelligence from kills

npc_dota_hero_antimage.threat: short-cooldown blinks, mana burn on every attack, and very fast farming into a late-game power spike
npc_dota_hero_antimage.kit: blinks constantly, burns mana on every attack, and farms fast toward a late-game spike

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.threat: a blink strike, heavy evasion, and critical strikes that delete a hero in two or three attacks
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.kit: blinks onto a target and kills it with critical strikes in two or three attacks

npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.threat: a spinning blade that is immune to magic, a healing ward, and a channelled untargetable attack
npc_dota_hero_juggernaut.kit: spins immune to magic, drops a healing ward, and channels an untargetable flurry of attacks

npc_dota_hero_slark.threat: escapes that remove debuffs, permanent stat stealing, and invisibility with regeneration out of vision
npc_dota_hero_slark.kit: removes debuffs while escaping, steals stats on hits, and regenerates out of enemy vision

npc_dota_hero_ursa.threat: stacking attack damage that melts single targets and Roshan very early
npc_dota_hero_ursa.kit: stacks damage on a single target with successive attacks and takes Roshan very early

npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.threat: a silence that damages over time, a movement trap, and pursuit of low-health heroes across the map
npc_dota_hero_bloodseeker.kit: silences with damage over time and runs down wounded heroes across the map

npc_dota_hero_sniper.threat: long attack range that punishes from outside the fight, and a global finishing shot
npc_dota_hero_sniper.kit: attacks from far outside the fight and finishes wounded heroes globally

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.threat: long-range physical damage, a silence, and a passive that lowers the enemy team's armour
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.kit: attacks from long range behind an agility aura, and is weak once enemies close the gap

npc_dota_hero_luna.threat: bouncing attacks that clear groups, and a large area magic burst at night
npc_dota_hero_luna.kit: bounces attacks between grouped units and casts a large area nuke at night

npc_dota_hero_spectre.threat: global joins to any fight, illusions that attack alongside them, and damage reflected back at attackers
npc_dota_hero_spectre.kit: joins any fight globally, reflects damage back at attackers, and scales on items rather than spells

npc_dota_hero_terrorblade.threat: strong illusions, a health swap that instantly puts a hero near death, and very high attack damage
npc_dota_hero_terrorblade.kit: creates strong illusions and swaps health with a hero to put them near death

npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.threat: four illusions that farm and push lanes, plus an area sleep that resets fights
npc_dota_hero_naga_siren.kit: farms several lanes with four illusions and resets fights with an area sleep

npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.threat: an endless stream of illusions that are hard to tell apart from the hero
npc_dota_hero_phantom_lancer.kit: floods a fight with illusions that are hard to tell apart from the hero

npc_dota_hero_meepo.threat: several controllable copies that gang up on one hero and farm several lanes at once
npc_dota_hero_meepo.kit: controls several copies that farm separately but must all arrive on one target together

npc_dota_hero_broodmother.threat: many spiderlings that push lanes and swarm heroes, backed by webs that give speed and vision
npc_dota_hero_broodmother.kit: pushes with spiderlings and fights inside webs that grant speed and vision

npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.threat: summoned units that push and scout, plus a single-target stun that lasts a long time
npc_dota_hero_beastmaster.kit: commands summoned units for pushing and scouting, and lands a long single-target stun

npc_dota_hero_invoker.threat: a wide spell set covering area stuns, heavy magic burst, and wave clear from long range
npc_dota_hero_invoker.kit: combines a wide spell set, needing mana and short cooldowns to use several of them in one fight

npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.threat: repeated blinks, a scream that silences, and high area magic burst
npc_dota_hero_queenofpain.kit: blinks in and out repeatedly while dealing area magic damage and silencing

npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.threat: unlimited repositioning while mana lasts, with a stun and steady magic damage
npc_dota_hero_storm_spirit.kit: repositions endlessly as long as mana lasts, spending it to both chase and escape

npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.threat: damage blocked from ranged attacks, invisible traps, and very high burst physical damage
npc_dota_hero_templar_assassin.kit: blocks ranged damage, plants invisible traps, and bursts single targets down

npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.threat: sustained healing, heavy magic damage in fights, and an ultimate that stops a hero from respawning
npc_dota_hero_necrolyte.kit: heals through fights, deals heavy magic damage, and stops a killed hero respawning

npc_dota_hero_omniknight.threat: a heal that also removes debuffs and an ultimate that makes allies immune to physical damage
npc_dota_hero_omniknight.kit: heals and dispels allies and makes them immune to physical damage

npc_dota_hero_dazzle.threat: an ability that stops an ally dying for several seconds, plus large armour swings
npc_dota_hero_dazzle.kit: stops an ally dying for several seconds and swings armour heavily in a fight

npc_dota_hero_huskar.threat: damage that scales as their own health drops, a single-target magic immunity, and long-range attacks
npc_dota_hero_huskar.kit: fights deliberately at low health, where its damage scales up but it is easy to kill

npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.threat: a second life after dying, a stun, and skeletons that add physical damage
npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king.kit: comes back to life once after dying, stuns, and adds damage with skeletons

npc_dota_hero_sven.threat: a stun through units and a massive temporary attack-damage buff for the whole team
npc_dota_hero_sven.kit: stuns through units and gives the whole team a large temporary attack-damage buff

npc_dota_hero_medusa.threat: a very large mana pool that absorbs damage, attacks that split to nearby heroes, and an area stone gaze
npc_dota_hero_medusa.kit: absorbs damage into a very large mana pool and splits attacks between nearby heroes

npc_dota_hero_alchemist.threat: extremely fast farming into an early power spike, with an acid spray that strips armour
npc_dota_hero_alchemist.kit: farms extremely fast and spikes early on items bought well ahead of schedule

npc_dota_hero_tinker.threat: repeated long-range magic bursts with resetting cooldowns and constant repositioning
npc_dota_hero_tinker.kit: resets its own cooldowns to cast the same nukes again and again from long range

npc_dota_hero_weaver.threat: invisibility, a time rewind that undoes their death, and attacks that strip armour
npc_dota_hero_weaver.kit: rewinds its own death, strips armour on attacks, and slips in and out invisible

npc_dota_hero_mirana.threat: a long-range stun, a leap, and team-wide invisibility that enables ambushes
npc_dota_hero_mirana.kit: lands a long-range stun, leaps out of danger, and turns the team invisible

npc_dota_hero_nevermore.threat: stacking area magic bursts from range and a large attack-damage aura that lowers enemy damage
npc_dota_hero_nevermore.kit: stacks area magic bursts from range and lowers the attack damage of nearby enemies

npc_dota_hero_venomancer.threat: heavy slowing poison over time and plague wards that give vision and chip damage
npc_dota_hero_venomancer.kit: spreads slowing poison and plants wards for vision and steady chip damage

npc_dota_hero_viper.threat: a slow that stacks on every attack and damage over time that grows the longer a fight lasts
npc_dota_hero_viper.kit: stacks slows on every attack and grinds enemies down the longer a fight lasts

npc_dota_hero_batrider.threat: an ultimate that drags one hero into their team, with damage over time and forced turning
npc_dota_hero_batrider.kit: drags one hero back into its team while burning them, and has to survive the trip

npc_dota_hero_sand_king.threat: a channelled area stun followed by heavy area magic damage, plus invisibility between fights
npc_dota_hero_sand_king.kit: arrives unseen and channels an area stun, following it with heavy area damage

npc_dota_hero_leshrac.threat: constant area magic damage that melts grouped heroes and structures alike
npc_dota_hero_leshrac.kit: deals constant area magic damage to grouped heroes and to structures

npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.threat: magic immunity on demand, heavy lifesteal, and an unavoidable attack-speed chase
npc_dota_hero_life_stealer.kit: turns magic immune on demand, heals from its attacks, and chases without letting go

npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.threat: constant repositioning between remnants, magic immunity on demand, and area chain damage
npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit.kit: moves between remnants, goes magic immune, and chains damage across a whole fight

npc_dota_hero_puck.threat: many escapes, a silencing orb, and an area ultimate that stuns and interrupts
npc_dota_hero_puck.kit: escapes repeatedly and lands an area ultimate that stuns and interrupts

npc_dota_hero_pugna.threat: structure and hero burn, a ward that amplifies magic damage, and a channelled life drain
npc_dota_hero_pugna.kit: burns structures and heroes, and channels a life drain that must not be broken

npc_dota_hero_undying.threat: stolen strength, a zombie swarm that slows heavily, and constant lane pressure
npc_dota_hero_undying.kit: steals strength in fights, slows with a zombie swarm, and pressures the lane constantly

npc_dota_hero_oracle.threat: an ability that makes an ally briefly immortal and immune to damage, undoing burst kills
npc_dota_hero_oracle.kit: makes an ally briefly immune to damage and death, undoing an enemy burst kill

npc_dota_hero_winter_wyvern.threat: a large healing shield and an ultimate that turns one hero's allies against them
npc_dota_hero_winter_wyvern.kit: shields an ally with a large heal and turns one hero's own allies against them
